families.basis: root cause records PTFE packing worn, hardened or seized against a moving element (valve stem, rotating drum gland, compressor rod); YD-2301 gland rows and KC-4501 rod packing are the same wear-out mechanism of a PTFE dynamic seal. Scope: a packing is the static sealing element compressed against a moving surface, so WO-240085 'PTFE piston rings worn beyond limit' (KC-4501 2nd-stage piston and rider rings, where the PTFE ring is the moving element running on the cylinder bore) is deliberately out of this family and belongs to no family; it is a wear-out of the same material on the same machine and OPL-KC-4501-04 lists it beside WO-240094, so the exclusion is stated rather than left to be inferred (PS-V8)

member_basis.WO-240028: packing: PTFE 4526L discharge gland packing worn beyond service limit (YD-2301)
member_basis.WO-240029: packing: PTFE 4505L feed-end gland packing hardened and worn (YD-2301)
member_basis.WO-240094: packing: PTFE pressure packing rings worn at distance piece (KC-4501)
member_basis.WO-240135: packing: stem seized in PTFE packing, over-tightened + fines (LV-6701)
member_basis.WO-240138: packing: PTFE V-ring stem packing worn (LV-6701)

families.basis: root cause records misalignment or a worn / spalled bearing, crosshead or coupling in a rotating drive train; KC-4501 is represented by WO-240088 (crosshead pin clearance) alone, because WO-240091's recorded root cause is a restricted oil supply passage, not a degraded bearing (PS-09)

member_basis.WO-240003: misalignment: angular misalignment 0.12 mm/100mm after foundation settlement (GA-1201A)
member_basis.WO-240004: bearing: outer race spalling on DE bearing due to prolonged misalignment (GA-1201A)
member_basis.WO-240007: coupling: Rexnord coupling element cracked from repeated misalignment cycles (GA-1201A)
member_basis.WO-240034: bearing: NDE trunnion support roller bearing worn/spalled (YD-2301)
member_basis.WO-240166: bearing: spherical roller fan bearing worn (CT-7801)

families.basis: root cause records fouling deposits on heat-transfer surfaces raising dP or degrading heat transfer (WO-240119 is a planned inspection row kept for the mechanism record; it is outside the unplanned-failure population)

member_basis.WO-240089: fouling: waterside fouling of intercooler tubes, high interstage temperature (KC-4501)
member_basis.WO-240110: fouling: hexane / polymer fines deposit on tube bores, high tube dP (EA-5601)
member_basis.WO-240119: fouling: general fouling found at scheduled bundle inspection (EA-5601, planned row)
member_basis.WO-240164: fouling: degraded oil and fouled gearbox oil cooler, TSHH-7803 rising (CT-7801)

families.basis: root cause records a spiral-wound gasket unevenly seated or relaxed at a bolted joint (manway, channel flange, body/bonnet)

member_basis.WO-240062: gasket: spiral-wound gasket unevenly seated at bottom manway (DC-3401A)
member_basis.WO-240111: gasket: spiral-wound channel gasket relaxed / damaged (EA-5601)
member_basis.WO-240145: gasket: spiral-wound body gasket relaxed at body/bonnet joint (LV-6701)
member_basis.WO-240195: gasket: SW gasket unevenly seated at manway (FA-8901)

families.basis: root cause records the lubrication supply itself as the failed item: a starved or restricted oil passage or a failed lube oil pump and relief setting, with the bearing named as the location rather than the mechanism. WO-240164 (degraded oil and fouled oil cooler) is not a member: its cooler is a fouled heat-transfer surface, so it stays in 'exchanger fouling and thermal performance' and every row belongs to exactly one family (CR-20)

member_basis.WO-240084: lube oil supply: lube oil pump gears worn and relief valve set low, discharge restored to 2.5 barg (KC-4501)
member_basis.WO-240091: lube oil supply: restricted oil supply groove to No.2 main bearing, passage cleared and clearance checked; the bearing is the location, not the failed item (KC-4501)

method.canonical: NFKC, soft hyphens joined, whitespace collapsed
method.labels_note: machine-drafted labels present (packages/coverage_labels.draft.json); human adjudication pending (OQ-6); deck numbers remain the proxy
method.recipe: A work-order narrative field is reduced to content words (lower-cased alphanumeric tokens, tag-like tokens such as VSHH-1201 kept whole, a fixed stop list removed, single-character tokens dropped, fields with fewer than three content words skipped). The same tokeniser is applied to the lesson text. Each same-asset lesson document is scanned separately with a window of twice the field's word count, one word at a time; the field's score is the largest share of its distinct words found inside one window; the work order's score is the best of its three fields; it is uncovered when that share does not exceed t = 0.62. Generous layer: the full lesson text. Strict layer: seven header fields rebuilt from the parsed lesson (lesson id, title, equipment name, area / unit, related interlock, P&ID reference, classification) plus sections 1 PURPOSE, 2 SAFETY PRECAUTIONS, 3 TOOLS & MATERIALS, 4 DETAILED PROCEDURE and 6 KEY LEARNING POINTS, composed from the parsed lesson, so that section 5 COMMON PROBLEMS & TROUBLESHOOTING, the page watermark and anything after it, and anything after the 'Prepared by' footer are excluded wherever the extractor places them.
method.recipe_sha256_of: sha256 over the bytes of harness/coverage.py and harness/opl.py, in that order
method.skip_rule: fields with fewer than 3 content tokens skipped; work order with no scoreable field scores 0
method.stop_list_sha256_of: sorted stop words joined by newline, UTF-8
method.strict_cut_marker: This is sample data provided for CALIBER purposes only
method.strict_rule: the strict layer is COMPOSED from the parsed lesson (harness.opl.strict_text): the seven header fields REBUILT from the parse (lesson id, title, equipment name, area / unit, related interlock, P&ID reference, classification) - not the header text as the extractor emits it - followed by sections 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, joined in that order. It is not stripped from the whole text, because stripping removes only what the extractor happens to place between the two section headings (P10). Each section body ends at the page watermark 'This is sample data provided for CALIBER purposes only', because the extractor emits out-of-flow table cells after it (P10b).
strict_section_headings: rebuilt header fields: lesson id, title, equipment name, area / unit, related interlock, P&ID reference, classification
